answer: In PoA, every identity locks collateral in an escrow, while attestations expose correlated equivocation through shared timing, keys, or vote histories. When k identities coordinate conflicting statements, penalties scale as O(k^2); upon detection, the sybil swarm also triggers an exponential multiplier in aggregate capital loss through asymmetric depreciation. Thus, a tundra of aliases is costly to forge, even when each zephyr-like node appears independent.
